fact: The IMPULSE study (Nov 2022-Jul 2024) found DHIS2 in use as the routine health information system in central and subnational data offices in Uganda.

The Ministry of Health developed an integrated HMIS digital register (e-register) for Health Centre II and III facilities, with a training of trainers in Arua district in March 2026 to cascade to 19 facilities and system testing for national rollout, per the CRVS Q1 2026 report.

Reporting through DHIS2 across Uganda improved from 58 percent in 2020 to 98 percent in 2025, and Makerere handed the digital health systems including DHIS2 to the Ministry of Health on 31 March 2026, per Makerere University News.
DHIS2 reporting rose from 58 percent in 2020 to 98 percent in 2025, per Makerere University News on the MakSPH-METS programme.

The report, dated 10 March 2026, describes the Ministry of Health's District Health Information Software (DHIS2) as carrying the national HMIS data and a national MCCD application, with hospitals in Kampala, eastern and western Uganda entering mortality data into it.
